body.name: studentized cone-profile confidence set
body.construction: Compute \(m_N\), \(q_N\), \(H_N\), and \(\widehat\gamma_N\); minimize analytically over the line loading for each \(p\in[p_{\min},p_{\max}]\); set \(T_N(b)=N\widehat\gamma_N^{-1}d_{H_N}(m_N-b\mathbf 1,\mathcal C_N)^2\), \(C_N=\{b\in\mathcal B:T_N(b)\le\chi^2_{2,1-\alpha}\}\), and \(\widehat\beta_N\in\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{b\in\mathcal B}T_N(b)\).
